nuggets.text: Jim Harbaugh once played quarterback for the Chargers, in San Diego in 1999 and 2000.
Jim and John Harbaugh were the first brothers to be NFL head coaches; John now coaches the New York Giants.
Jim Harbaugh earned the nickname "Captain Comeback" for fourth-quarter wins as an Indianapolis Colts quarterback.
Chargers coordinator Mike McDaniel lost his cap at Broncos camp as a kid; the staffer who bought him a new one married his mom.
The Chargers name was chosen partly because fans at games were yelling "Charge!"
SoFi Stadium, shared by the Chargers and Rams, is the most expensive stadium ever built, at $5.5 billion.
SoFi Stadium's double-sided Infinity Screen weighs 2.2 million pounds and shows 80 million pixels.
Justin Herbert set out to get better at chess after teammate Rashawn Slater beat him on a 2024 road trip.
Chargers rookie Akheem Mesidor, born in Ottawa, was the top prospect for the 2026 CFL draft but went undrafted there.
Justin Herbert holds the NFL record for most passing yards in a quarterback's first five seasons, with 21,093.
